|errata_history={{Card errata/My Sister Has It}}
This is the original printing, represented by the matching printed face in the August 2025 release sheet. It is not the current version; the current text is [[My Sister Has It (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image in the repository revision of 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-msh-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e6f69d52659159101b647b96a00a4cd5939e189e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/e6f69d52659159101b647b96a00a4cd5939e189e e6f69d5] (9 April 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Virtual Set 25 preview card. The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 9). Text: “During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited. OR Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters.”
*: This version's card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 9, file created 10 August 2025, with the same words ([[:File:V25-L-mysisterhasit-2025-08-10-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on this page.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[My Sister Has It (Errata)]]): PC card image in the repository revision of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-msh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the card changes from a Used Interrupt to a Used or Lost Interrupt: the first option (“During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited.”) is removed, the other two become the USED text, and a LOST text is added (“If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”). Text: “USED: Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters. LOST: If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
